lines: I prefer danger in books. Books usually stay on the correct side of the shelf.
There were several endings I disliked. I am glad we reached this chapter.
I made it back with several new reasons to prefer quiet shelves.
That chapter had too much running and not enough punctuation.
I survived, though my notes from the event are mostly shaking lines.
The village door has never looked so beautifully constructed.
I would shelve that experience under never again.
Home is a short word. It felt very large when I reached it.
When danger came close, nobody had time to sound brave first.
You learn a lot about a village when everyone hears the bell at once.
